studies.title: Phase Transitions in Colloid-Polymer Mixtures in Microgravity
studies.description: Study of phase transitions in colloid-polymer mixtures under microgravity conditions.

studies.title: Pool Boiling Heat Transfer Mechanisms in Low Gravity: Numerical Experiments of MABE and NPBX Data
studies.description: Numerical analysis of pool boiling heat transfer in low gravity using MABE and NPBX data.
studies.approach: Computational modeling of boiling heat transfer.

studies.title: Fabrication of Amorphous Metals in Space
studies.description: Fabrication of Amorphous Metals in Space (FAMIS). Processing of glass-forming alloys (Vitreloy 106 and Zr48Cu47.5Al4Co0.5) with tungsten particles in microgravity to study dendrite formation and mechanical properties.
studies.approach: Flight experiment processed 12 samples of two glass-forming alloys with different volume fractions (5%, 15%, 30%) and diameters of W spheres (25-36 μm and 140-150 μm). Samples held at 1200°C for 120 min in Low Gradient Furnace. Ampoule MEE02583-005 sealed under negative pressure of ultra-high purity Argon. Samples 7-12 detailed in CoC include Zr48Cu47.5Al4Co0.5 and Vitreloy 106 with 5-15%W particles of varying sizes.

studies.title: Advanced Combustion via Microgravity Experiments / Cool Flames Investigation with Gases
studies.description: Advanced Combustion via Microgravity Experiments / Cool Flames Investigation with Gases. Spherical diffusion flame tests aboard the ISS to study cool flame kinetics for the first time under microgravity conditions.
studies.approach: Perform spherical diffusion flame tests aboard the International Space Station. Consider multiple fuels, a range of reactant dilutions, flow rates, and pressures for normal and inverse convection directions. Observe the flames with a broad suite of cameras, radiometers, photomultiplier tubes, and thermocouples. Hypotheses include demonstrating steady-state cool diffusion flames on spherical porous burners, cool flames with propane/n-butane/n-pentane, wide range of Zst/Tad/pressures, inverse cool diffusion flames, and extinction/transition behaviors with flow rate changes.

studies.title: Micromechanics-based Modeling of Cement Solidified in the Microgravity
studies.description: Predict mechanical properties of cement hydrated in microgravity using SEM images and NASMAT modeling.
studies.approach: Converted sparse SEM data to high-fidelity 3D microstructures with deep learning, then used NASMAT for homogenized properties. Higher porosity observed in space samples.

studies.title: Investigating the Structure of Paramagnetic Aggregates from Colloidal Emulsions - 4 (InSPACE)
studies.description: Multiscale analysis of dissipative self-assembly of polarizable colloids in microgravity.
studies.approach: This ISS investigation was conducted using magnetic prolate ellipsoids with aspect ratios ranging from 2:1 to 4:1. Experiments involving spheres were also conducted for comparison. The sample material consisted of randomly oriented nano Fe3O4 coated polymer beads within a fluid filled vial, creating a magnetorheological fluid (MR). The vials were subjected to a pulsed magnetic field, creating three-dimensional structures. Particle orientation was determined from birefringence measurements using crossed polarizers.

studies.title: The origin of fragility in high-temperature oxide liquids - towards fabrication of novel non-equilibrium oxides
studies.description: Investigation of fragility in high-temperature oxide liquids for novel non-equilibrium oxides.
studies.approach: Density, thermal expansion, viscosity, and surface tension of molten oxides were measured using the Electrostatic Levitation Furnace (ELF) onboard the ISS. Measurements included silhouette imaging and drop oscillation over a wide range of temperatures, including deep supercooling.

studies.title: Aging Colloid Gels
studies.description: Aging Colloid Gels - Study of temporal evolution and asymptotic behavior of colloidal gels over multiple time scales.
studies.approach: Examines slow changes in colloidal gels after initialization, focusing on Brownian time scales, particle contact and sticking, depletion forces, and coarsening processes. Uses microscopy and light scattering studies. Larger particles experience stronger depletion forces leading to faster incorporation into the gel structure.

studies.title: Solidification and Gravity
studies.description: Solidification and Gravity - Pre-flight sample design discussion from Materials Science Forum Volumes 215-216 (page 59).
studies.approach: Discusses pre-flight solidification experiments and sample design considerations under gravity effects. Part of broader solidification research related to particle engulfment and interface dynamics.

studies.title: Plant Water Management
studies.description: Investigation related to plant water management in space environments.
studies.approach: PWM employed passive capillary-based fluidic systems to deliver water and nutrients to plant root zones under microgravity aboard the ISS. Growth modules were designed with controlled channel geometries and surface-wetting properties to direct liquid flow, manage gas-liquid separation, and maintain root-zone aeration. Both hydroponic and soil-based configurations were tested.

studies.title: Validation of a CFD Model for Gas-Liquid Flows in Packed Bed Reactors to Enable Thermo-Fluid Analysis in Microgravity
studies.description: Validation of CFD models for gas-liquid flows in packed bed reactors (PBRE) for microgravity thermo-fluid analysis. Focus on two-phase flows in life support and thermal control systems for spacecraft, space stations, and lunar/Mars habitats. Capillary forces dominate in low gravity.
studies.approach: Developed interface-resolved CFD simulations using VOF method in ANSYS Fluent on representative element volumes (REV) of packed beds. Introduced modified Weber (We*) and Bond (Bo*) numbers for pore-scale force balance between inertia, capillary, and buoyancy. Calibrated two-fluid models by fitting interphase drag coefficients to PSI data. Validated against visual images and pressure drop across bubbly, slug, core-annular, and stratified regimes at full and reduced gravity.

studies.title: Particle Engulfment and Pushing By Solidifying Interfaces
studies.description: Study of particle engulfment and pushing during solidification at interfaces.
studies.approach: The experimental approach was to perform directional solidification experiments with a pure metal, aluminum, doped with low concentrations of particles to study particle engulfment and pushing by solidifying interfaces under microgravity and terrestrial conditions.

studies.title: Computational and Experimental Analysis of SPICE Data Sets
studies.description: Ground investigation to understand soot formation discrepancies between 1g and 0g flames using SPICE data. Integrated computational and experimental methods to derive temperature distributions and soot volume fractions from over 1600 raw DSLR images.
studies.approach: Combined image processing (color-ratio pyrometry on Nikon NEF images), experimental diagnostics, and detailed soot modeling including radiation re-absorption and discrete-sectional aggregate formation. Simulations for Yale and ACME burners under normal and microgravity conditions.

studies.title: Concurrent Flame Spread Modeling using Flamelet Generated Manifolds in Microgravity with Comparison to BASS Experiments using Two-Color Tomography
studies.description: Modeling of concurrent flame spread in microgravity using FGM, compared to BASS experiments.
studies.approach: The approach combined high-resolution computational modeling with experimental validation to study concurrent flame spread in microgravity. A previously developed computational framework was employed to run fully coupled simulations of fluid–solid responses, focusing on materials subject to charring and ablation. The unsteady FGM method was implemented and tested on various BASS geometries, including flat sheets, spheres, and rod-shaped PMMA samples, as well as wax cylinders.

documents.title: Validation of a CFD Model for Gas-Liquid Flows in Packed Bed Reactors
documents.summary: Final RPPR report (Grant 80NSSC22K0290, 2021-2024). Details VOF simulations in ANSYS Fluent on REV geometries, introduction of modified We* and Bo* numbers for pore-scale force balance, and calibration of two-fluid models against PBRE pressure drop and visual data.
